title: EcoVGGT: Pinned-Key Inference for Efficient and Streamable Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction from Long Videos
abstract: arXiv:2611.18099v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward multi-view transformers such as VGGT recover the cameras and geometry of a video in one pass, but the cost of their cross-frame attention grows quadratically with the frame count, and their accuracy drops on long videos. Most remedies approximate attention over all frames within a budget or select a few keys by their content. We hypothesize that the keys of a long video can be chosen without looking at its content, and our experiments on VGGT and $\pi^3$ support it: a few dozen evenly spread frames can serve as the keys of every frame. We present EcoVGGT, a training-free inference framework whose keys form a Pinned Key Set of 31 such frames. A pin pass stores their tokens in a Scene Cache, and the other frames read it in independent batches that reproduce joint inference with these keys exactly, at a constant cost per frame. translated_title: EcoVGGT：面向长视频高效且可流式前馈三维重建的固定键推理方法
translated_abstract: 诸如 VGGT 这类前馈多视角 Transformer 能够在一次前向传播中恢复视频的相机位姿与几何信息，但其跨帧注意力的计算代价随帧数呈二次方增长，且在长视频上的精度会下降。现有的大多数解决方案要么在计算预算内对所有帧的注意力进行近似，要么根据内容选择少量关键帧。我们假设长视频的注意力键无需查看其内容即可选定，并且在 VGGT 和 π³ 上的实验支持了这一假设：几十帧均匀分布的帧即可作为所有帧的键。我们提出了 EcoVGGT，这是一个无需训练的推理框架，其键构成一个由 31 帧均匀分布帧组成的固定键集。一次固定遍历将这些帧的 token 存入场景缓存，其余各帧以独立批次读取该缓存，从而精确复现与这些键的联合推理，且每帧成本恒定。在线流式模式可在录制过程中更新固定帧。六个中间全局块对齐各帧……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EcoVGGT 提出了一种无需训练的推理框架，仅用 31 个均匀分布的帧构成固定键集并配合场景缓存机制，将跨帧注意力成本从随帧数二次方增长降为每帧恒定成本，实现了长视频的高效、可流式的前馈三维重建。
en_tdlr: EcoVGGT is a training-free inference framework that uses a Pinned Key Set of 31 evenly spread frames with a Scene Cache, reducing cross-frame attention cost from quadratic in frame count to constant per frame, enabling efficient and streamable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long videos.
